title: Connect Zalo and WhatsApp in wizard step 1
source: Your prototype https://newchat-bridge.vercel.app/ (screens marked "theirs"), plus screens drawn by the BA in the same look on top of it (marked "added"), approved by the user. Where a criterion gives other words or behaviour than a screen, the criterion wins.

screens.title: Step 1, nothing connected
screens.shows: Two channel cards and a disabled Next button (theirs)
text: Click Zalo or WhatsApp below to scan its QR code and link your account.
Pair your personal sales account or official OA to start syncing.
Link international WhatsApp personal or business profiles.

screens.title: Zalo QR code with countdown
screens.shows: The Zalo card turned to its QR code, countdown, regenerate and cancel (theirs)
text: Click Zalo or WhatsApp below to scan its QR code and link your account.
Link international WhatsApp personal or business profiles.

screens.title: QR code expired
text: Click Zalo or WhatsApp below to scan its QR code and link your account.
Link international WhatsApp personal or business profiles.

screens.title: Zalo connected
screens.shows: Connected card with name, phone, badge and Re-scan; Next enabled (theirs)
text: Account connected. You can link the second channel or proceed to DropNoise.
Link international WhatsApp personal or business profiles.

screens.title: Pairing code link on the WhatsApp card
screens.shows: The "Use pairing code instead" link under the WhatsApp button; agreed card texts (added)
text: Click Zalo or WhatsApp below to scan its QR code and link your account.
Pair your personal Zalo account to start syncing.

screens.title: WhatsApp pairing: phone number
screens.shows: Phone number field and "Get pairing code" (added)
text: Click Zalo or WhatsApp below to scan its QR code and link your account.
Pair your personal Zalo account to start syncing.
Enter the phone number of your WhatsApp account, with country code.

screens.title: WhatsApp pairing: code shown
screens.shows: The 8-character code, where to enter it and "Waiting for your phone..." (added)
text: Click Zalo or WhatsApp below to scan its QR code and link your account.
Pair your personal Zalo account to start syncing.
On your phone: WhatsApp › Linked devices › Link a device › Link with phone number instead.

notShown.why: an absence: the Zalo card has no pairing link
error state not drawn; its words are in the criterion

differences: The "Use pairing code instead" link is on the WhatsApp card in every state with a pair button, though only the added screens draw it.
The "Simulate Scan" button is prototype-only and is not built (C10).
The card texts "personal sales account or official OA" and "personal or business profiles" are replaced by those of C1 (proposal OS3).
